sonnet.problem: The card asks the baker to pick the exact wording of Eli's question. Nothing earlier lets the baker reason it out, and all three answers are equally plausible, so the pick is luck.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.

sonnet.problem: The card asks the baker to guess the wording of Eli's question about the man who sins against the LORD. The right answer also hangs on the hard word 'intercede', and the wrong answers are made-up phrasings nobody could rule out from the earlier cards.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.
